Subject: SIG intake request & preferred windows

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the intro last week — MosaicAI is ready to kick off the SIG/CAIQ intake. We're aiming to complete the questionnaire and collect evidence within the next 3 weeks to meet our procurement timeline. A couple of things up front:

- Preferred call windows: Aug 12–14 (09:00–12:00 PDT) or Aug 17 (14:00–17:00 PDT).
- Primary concerns: log retention windows, cross-region data flow, and key-management integrations.

Attached is our intake packet (MosaicAI_SIG_Request.pdf). Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the direct evidence point-of-contact and where we should upload samples (logs, config exports)? Also let us know if you have an NDA / data-sharing agreement — we can sign quickly through DocuSign.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Security Operations
MosaicAI
